thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — multiple containers in gpu-pool-12 are crashlooping with segfaults. Elevated error rate for /v1/generate affecting a few enterprise tenants.
oncall-sre: I'm on it, grabbing logs now. Can we confirm which nodes?
eng-runtime: seeing OOM followed by SIGSEGV in the fused_attention kernel on host-gpu-12, host-gpu-14. Kernel message snippet in logs.
mike: copying recent kubectl output:
```
$ kubectl -n redwood logs runtime-xyz -c runtime
[2025-11-02T14:12:05Z] ERROR: malloc failed: out of memory
[2025-11-02T14:12:06Z] runtime: segfault at 0x7ffdeadbeef in fused_attention.cu:unroll_kernel+0x1f
container exited with code 139
```
sara: Customer impact: two enterprise customers see 502s intermittently, ~3% requests failing in region-us-west2. Alerting CS.
support-engineer: Notified account teams, filing post-incident flag. Do we have a safe fallback model?
eng-runtime: Yes — we can route to quantized-cpu fallback or a smaller fp16 variant that uses different kernels. Prepare routing rule.
oncall-sre: Immediate mitigations I will run: cordon host-gpu-12/14, evict pods, scale down runtime replicas to avoid cold-start thundering herd, enable fallback routing.
mike: Running drain on host-gpu-12: `kubectl drain host-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — started.
infra-bot: Host host-gpu-12 shows GPU memory spike before crash; nvml logs attached to node.
eng-runtime: Hypothesis: recent fused-kernel rollout (v1.3.4) introduced a regression under high sequence lengths that triggers an out-of-bounds access when the NVLINK transfer races with the allocator. We'll revert the rollout on dedicated pools.
sara: Can we do a targeted rollback on gpu-pool-12 and keep other pools online?
eng-runtime: Yes — creating a canary rollback: pin runtime-image:v1.3.3 on gpu-pool-12 only, and set rollout.pause for v1.3.4.
oncall-sre: Action list: 1) cordon + drain problematic nodes (done) 2) scale replicas to safe floor (done) 3) enable fallback routes to quantized-cpu (in progress) 4) revert kernel rollout on affected pools (in progress) 5) collect core dumps and GPU driver traces and hand to eng-runtime for root cause.
mike: Collected core dump: `/var/crash/runtime-xyz.core.gz` and `nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps` logs. Uploading to /tmp/incidents/5076543210.
eng-runtime: Please also capture `gdb --batch -ex 'bt full' -ex 'info threads' --core runtime-xyz.core runtime-binary` output and attach. We'll triage.
sara: Customer comms: sending interim note that we are mitigating and that impact is limited to region-us-west2, ETA for full mitigation ~30-60m.
support-engineer: :thumbsup: keeping paging channel updated.
eng-runtime: If rollback confirms kernel regression, plan is to disable fused attention kernel for >8k tokens and route long sequences to fallback implementation. We'll prepare a hotfix patch.
oncall-sre: Handoff to night oncall in 25m — @eng-runtime, if you need an on-call follow up please escalate to the pager.
eng-runtime: Will monitor core dumps; if failures persist after rollback we'll escalate to driver vendor.
infra-bot: Nodes host-gpu-12, host-gpu-14 are cordoned and drained. Pods rescheduled to host-gpu-18 which runs v1.3.3. Error rate dropped to ~0.4% over last 5m.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated to Sev2. Logged timeline and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/5076543210
oncall-sre: marking the thread for postmortem and attaching raw logs. Thanks all — switching to watch mode. :eyes:
